text:
zoe: late-night watercooler q — looking for a one-off movie (<=2h) or an album to keep me company while debugging. also any short book recs (sub-200 pages)? quick hits pls

kai: movie — Coherence (2013). dinner-party sci-fi, low budget, gets weirder and better. 89min.

marta: album — Since I Left You — The Avalanches. nostalgic collage, perfect low-key late-night listen.

diego: book — The Sense of an Ending (Julian Barnes). ~150 pages, sharp and unsettling. good for one-sitting reads.

sara: movie — The Farewell (2019). 100min, funny and quietly bittersweet. great mood.

zoe: adding: anyone have a short fantasy novella rec? summer mood but cozy.

kai: novella rec: The Emperor's Soul (Brandon Sanderson). ~40k words, tight and satisfying.

marta: also: album rec for coding focus: Moon Safari — Air. mellow but propulsive.

diego: guilty-pleasure single: "Bubble Pop" (placeholder)  sing in the shower energy. :microphone:

sara: giphy-bot: [GIF: tiny tea cup and book  cute slow clap]

zoe: love these. will start with Coherence then maybe Moon Safari on repeat while I triage that bug.

kai: if anyone wants, I'll drop a short playlist later (30-45min) with Avalanches + Air + a couple singles.

marta: vote: pin the book picks to #book-club? short reads are easy wins.

diego: yes please pin. also +1 for Emperor's Soul if you like clever worldbuilding.

sara: last rec: short documentary — "20 Feet from Stardom" (2013). under 1.5h, music-focused, great watch.

zoe: perfect. thanks team  bookmarking all. good night and may your debug logs be friendly :stars:
